newsitem.title: UK: Nigeria raises May crude prices by 11-16 cents.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria raises May crude prices by 11-16 cents.

text.p: State Nigerian National Petroleum Corp (NNPC) raised crude contract price formulas for May loadings by 10-16 cents a barrel, traders said.
NNPC set Bonny Light and Qua Iboe (BQ) for May at Dated Brent plus 15 cents, up from Dated Brent plus four cents in April.
Forcados for May was set at Dated Brent -30 cents compared to Brent -40 cents in April.
Bonny Medium was raised by 10 cents for May to Brent less 40 cents.
Brass River went up 16 cents to Brent plus 25 cents.
Pennington rose 13 cents to Brent plus 35 cents.
NNPC set an option to price crude five days ahead of bill of lading at plus five cents, up from two cents for April.
An option for deferred pricing 14 days after bill of lading was left unchanged at five cents a barrel.
Escravos was raised by 11 cents to Brent plus seven cents.
